meta.name: Announcements
meta.description: Service notices, maintenance windows and incident updates for everyone.

announcements-reader.name: Announcement reader
announcements-reader.description: See published announcements (granted to everyone by default)

empty.current: No current announcements — all systems normal.

notFound: This announcement does not exist or is not published.

deleteBodyPublished: Everyone stops seeing it and it is removed for good. To keep it on record, archive it instead.

editor.hint: Everyone can see published announcements. They are also posted to the chat channels set up for announcements.
editor.title: Title
editor.windowHint: Optional. Published announcements are archived automatically when the window ends.
editor.pinnedHint: Pinned announcements stay above newer ones.

publish.name: Publishing an announcement
publish.description: Optional review before a post goes live. Conditions can use its type, whether it's pinned and whether it has a time window.

post_approved.label: My announcements approved
post_approved.title: Published: {title}
post_approved.body: Your announcement was approved and everyone can see it now.

submittedToast: Sent for approval — it goes live once approved
withdrawnToast: Withdrawn from review — back to draft
pendingHint: This announcement is waiting for approval. It is published automatically once approved; withdraw it to make changes.
